units.source_text: 且说源氏公子另有一个乳母，叫作左卫门的，他对她的信任仅次于做尼姑的大弍乳母。

en.t: Now Prince Genji had another nurse, called Saemon, whom he trusted second only to the nun, his nurse Daini.

units.source_text: 这左卫门乳母有一个女儿，叫作大辅命妇的，在禁中供职。

en.t: This nurse Saemon had a daughter called Taifu no Myobu, who served at court.

units.source_text: 她的父亲是皇族出身，叫作兵部大辅。

en.t: Her father was of imperial lineage and was known as Hyobu no Taifu.

units.source_text: 这大辅命妇是个青年风流女子，源氏公子入宫时也常常要她伺候。

en.t: This Taifu no Myobu was a young and elegant woman, and Prince Genji often had her attend him when he came to the palace.

units.source_text: 她母亲左卫门乳母后来和兵部大辅离婚，改嫁筑前守，跟着他赴任地去了。

en.t: Her mother, the nurse Saemon, later divorced Hyobu no Taifu, remarried the Governor of Chikuzen, and went with him to his post.

units.source_text: 因此大辅命妇依父亲而居，天天赴宫中供职。

en.t: For that reason, Taifu no Myobu lived under her father's protection and went to the palace every day to serve.
